content.label: Every parent asks
content.question: What if the visa is refused?

answers.title: Understand the reason
answers.detail: Read the refusal letter carefully. What was missing decides your next step.

answers.title: Fix the gap
answers.detail: Documents, proof of funds or your answers: whatever was weak, make it strong.

answers.title: Apply again
answers.detail: One refusal does not close the road. Prepare well and apply again.
